---
name: my-skill
description: Use this skill whenever building or editing any page of the Smash Point badminton court booking website.
---

1. The brand name is "Smash Point" and the tagline is "Book a court. Bring your game." Show both in the header of every page.
2. Tone of voice: friendly, short and energetic. Keep sentences under 15 words and speak to the visitor as "you".
3. Colours: primary #0B6E4F (court green), accent #F5B700 (shuttle yellow), text #1B1B1B, page background #F7F7F2, cards #FFFFFF. Use no other colours.
4. Fonts: headings in "Bebas Neue" and body text in "Poppins", both loaded from Google Fonts. Headings are uppercase.
5. Every page must have a header with the brand name, tagline and links to every page, and a footer that says "© 2026 Smash Point, Lahore · Open daily 7:00 am – 11:00 pm".
6. Write prices as "Rs 1,500": "Rs", a space, a comma for thousands, no decimals. Always say what the price covers, e.g. "Rs 1,500 / hour".
7. Write dates as "Sat, 28 Nov 2026" and times in 12-hour format, e.g. "7:00 pm".
8. Phone numbers have exactly 11 digits, shown as 0300-1234567. Every form must check this before submitting and show a clear error message if it is wrong.
9. Buttons have 8px rounded corners, a #F5B700 background and dark text, and say what they do ("Book court", "Split cost").
10. Use emoji (🏸 ⏰ 🎾) as icons. Never load images or files from other websites.
11. Use plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript only, with every file in the main folder. index.html is always the home page.
12. Never invent fake reviews, ratings or customer names.
